title: Recovering a Boolean sequence with final value true
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer and let $p:\{0,\ldots,m\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ satisfy $p(m)=\mathrm{true}$. The sequence of its first $m$ values, extended by a final value of true, is exactly $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a Boolean-valued function on the indices $0$ through $m$
